## Review budget

- [ ] The reviewable diff is normally no more than 25 files and no more than 1,000 changed lines, excluding generated files, lockfiles, tests, documentation, and planning notes.
- [ ] If it is larger, the PR explains why it cannot be split into smaller vertical slices.
